d: Long, straight lavender-purple hair with blunt bangs frames a mature, adult face with sharp, narrow turquoise eyes. The slender build is dressed in a black sleeveless gown featuring a plunging neckline, a high slit, and a decorative belt of silver rings, all draped under a massive, voluminous cloak of deep midnight-black feathers. The ensemble is completed with black opera gloves, black pointed heels, and a silver-topped brown walking cane.
